INNER HEAD. [3] [Arund.]
Cephalalgia ; hysterical.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Arund.]
Hair falls off entirely in children.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Arund.]
Inflammation of eyes, in children.
Catarrhal, rheumatic, or scrofulous ophthalmia.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Arund.]
The inflammation of ears commences with shooting pains, begins in concha, extends to external meatus ; finally, with itching a discharge of blood.
Purulent discharge from ears.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Arund.]
Coryza, with snuffling.
In beginning water runs from nose, later green mucus and thick, white, slimy masses ; with sneezing, pieces of indurated greenish mucus.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Arund.]
Stomacace.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Arund.]
Constant thirst in children ; after waking in morning.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Arund.]
Intestinal catarrh.
The stools at first hard, soon become loose.
Constant diarrhœa of nursing children.
Serious diarrhœa with teething children.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Arund.]
Uterine catarrh.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Arund.]
Teething children. See 20.
   

COUGH. [27] [Arund.]
Catarrhal cough.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Arund.]
Pulse rises to 90, later lessening.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Arund.]
Œdema of lower limbs.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Arund.]
Œdema of limbs.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Arund.]
Acute and chronic catarrhs.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Arund.]
Diseases of women and children.
